ModMetaData.name: BPC AreaRestriction OOB Fix 1.5
ModMetaData.author: Allen
ModMetaData.description:
RimWorld 1.5 compatibility guard for Better Pawn Control area-policy loading.
Prevents IndexOutOfRangeException in Verse.AI.Job.IsTargetOutsideArea when a current Job contains a target cell outside the target Area map bounds.
In-bounds targets retain vanilla behavior. Out-of-bounds or cross-map targets are treated as outside the allowed area so the vanilla Pawn_PlayerSettings setter can interrupt the invalid job normally.
